g.text: One Workload Identity pool per privilege

text.tspan: A principalSet spans every provider in its pool,
so mixing readers and writers in one pool mixes their grants.

g.text: typst-d2-mcp release.yml on v* → sign with the tap key in KMS
design system go-module.yml on v* → write module
two consumers, and a keyless SA for Dependabot → read
